resolution.quote:
This problem is related to qt5 used on ubuntu16.04.
Thanks for your advice. @k-okada

As correcting following two lines, it looks like working as shown in the attached screenshot.

notes: Independently verified. (1) E1: issue #250 body (fishcu, 2017-01-30) matches verbatim, including the PyQt4-workaround segfault and the two missing rocon packages (correctly relegated to notes as separate compositions); the migrated robotics.SE question 78536 fetched via Stack Exchange API and contains the full traceback verbatim (dashboard.py line 8 'from QtGui import QMessageBox, QAction' -> 'ImportError: cannot import name QMessageBox' under PluginManager._load_plugin). (2) E2/E3: provider mechanism read directly at python_qt_binding 0.3.1 binding_helper.py: line 103 'sys.modules[module_name] = module' (bare-name registration) and _load_pyqt's "_named_import('PyQt5.%s' % module_name)" — the Qt5 module layout is what python_qt_binding registers, so the consumer's QtGui-era references are removed/renamed elements; UPGRADE with inferred built-against 0.2.19 (last Qt4 release) is the tightest bound and the reasoning holds. Interface change, not build: the fix edits the consumer's import references. (3) Fix read directly: commit 61a75df ('change to use QtWidgets from QtGui for ubuntu16.04', parent 3d837662, 2017-02-22) changes exactly dashboard.py 'from QtGui import QMessageBox, QAction' -> 'from QtWidgets import QMessageBox, QAction' and battery_widget.py 'from python_qt_binding.QtGui import QToolButton' -> 'from QtWidgets import QToolButton' — the same two edits yuki-asano reported working (comment 281542245, same day, quoted above); stonier: 'Coming in 0.5.3, thanks @yuki-asano ' read in-thread. (4) Loudness loud_documented/activate: import error reported by rqt's plugin loader at plugin load. (5) Resolution observed: the two committed edits shown working on Ubuntu 16.04 + Kinetic against the kinetic python_qt_binding deb (0.3.1/0.3.2, identical layout per spec's diff argument, not contradicted by anything read).
